title: Provable Parameter-Free Fixed-Point Algorithms with Linear Convergence Rates
abstract: arXiv:2608.09022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we develop provable parameter-free fixed-point algorithms for contractive mappings, with an emphasis on automatically exploiting hidden contractivity without requiring prior knowledge of the contraction factor. Our first method is a parameter-free variant of the Halpern fixed-point iteration with no line-search, bisection, or prior estimate of the contraction factor, while retaining essentially the same per-iteration computational cost as classical fixed-point schemes. We establish explicit linear convergence rates for both the fixed-point residual and the distance to the unique fixed point. The second algorithm is also a parameter-free Halpern method, but it requires a line-search procedure to find a local estimate for the contraction factor, which may need a few additional operator evaluations. tldr: 本文提出了两种无需压缩因子先验知识的无参数Halpern不动点迭代算法，并证明了对不动点残差和到唯一不动点距离的显式线性收敛率。
